description: Human-approval policy for sheets-skill-library. Gates are attached to capabilities by risk tier and by keyword triggers; approval_required gates block execution until a named approver records a scoped, expiring approval.

review_before_publish.reason: A human must read the artefact before it leaves the workbook (export, share, send, publish).

backup_before_change.reason: A copy of the workbook must exist before destructive or bulk changes.

approval_required.reason: Risk tier is high or critical: a named human approves this capability for this workbook.

security_sign_off.reason: Critical risk: security/privacy owner confirms the data handling before execution.

external_integration_unavailable.reason: The capability needs an integration disabled in tools-config.json; deliver reviewed manual steps instead.

destructive_action.reason: The capability text contains a destructive verb (delete, drop, overwrite all, wipe).

publishing_action.reason: The capability distributes content (share link, email, PDF, HTML).

financial_exposure.reason: Financial data or money movement is involved.

external_dependency.reason: The capability depends on an external source (IMPORTRANGE, IMPORTXML, webhook); record owner, refresh and fallback.

privileged_script.reason: Apps Script, add-on or webhook code can act with the user's authority.

denied_without_approval: deleting rows or columns from a source sheet
installing an add-on or trigger in a shared workbook
pseudonymising data without keeping the re-identification key separate
